name: keyscout-mcp-autosetup
description: Match an API key to MCP servers and write client configs with no plaintext secrets.
long_description: Finds MCP servers in the Official MCP Registry that accept your key type, scores them A-F (automated heuristics, not an audit), previews client configs, and writes them into a sandbox folder (dry-run by default) so servers launch via an encrypted local vault instead of a plaintext key. No tool ever takes or returns a raw key.

tools.name: list_apis
tools.description: APIs it can match, with where to get each key

tools.name: detect_clients
tools.description: Which MCP clients have a config file (read-only)

tools.name: find_servers
tools.description: Registry servers that accept a key type, A-F scored

tools.name: preview_config
tools.description: Config each client would get; writes nothing

tools.name: apply_setup
tools.description: Write configs into a sandbox folder; dry-run by default
